sources.entry: Frappe Helpdesk - Helpdesk software which helps you streamline your company's support, offers an easy setup, clean user interface, and automation tools to resolve customer queries efficiently. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Frappe Helpdesk is an open-source ticket management tool for streamlining company customer support, with agent and customer portals, SLAs, assignment rules, a knowledge base, and saved replies.
summary.what_it_does: Frappe Helpdesk provides a ticketing system for handling customer queries, with separate portal views for support agents and customers. Administrators can define customizable SLAs to set and track response times, and configure auto-assignment rules that route tickets by priority, issue type, or workload. It includes a knowledge base where help articles can be created and searched, with customers shown relevant articles when they search for an issue. Agents can use saved replies for common questions, and analytics show each ticket's timeline, response times, and conversation summary. It is built on the Frappe Framework (Python and JavaScript) with a Vue-based Frappe UI front end.
use_cases: set and track SLA response times
reuse canned replies for common questions
how_to_run: Production: download the easy-install script (URL not included in the README text) and run python3 ./easy-install.py deploy with your project name, email, image ghcr.io/frappe/helpdesk, version stable, app helpdesk, and sitename.
Development with Docker: install Docker and docker compose, create a folder, download docker-compose.yml and init.sh, then run docker compose up -d.
Local development: install bench, run bench start, create a site with bench new-site helpdesk.test, then get and install the Telephony and Helpdesk apps and run bench build --app helpdesk.
Frontend dev: in frappe-bench/apps/helpdesk/desk run yarn install and yarn dev.
notable: Dual agent and customer portals, with the customer portal built as a Frappe Studio app
Knowledge base search that recommends relevant articles to customers
Official Frappe Cloud managed hosting option alongside self-hosting
Compatibility matrix tying branches to Frappe version-15, version-16, or develop
caveats: Article search needs Redis with the RediSearch module (e.g., Redis Stack).
The develop branch requires the Frappe develop branch, which ships Studio.
Local setup involves multiple steps including bench, Telephony app, and Helpdesk app installation.
